Docs.summary: Provides types to build, publish, and request slices of app content for display in other apps or system surfaces.

remarks.para: A contains a tree of objects. A supplies the content, and requests and pins slices. A identifies a supported data structure and revision.
The Android slice framework is deprecated from Android 15 (API level 35) and will receive no further updates. The Android reference recommends AppSearch for sending displayable data between apps.

para.format: Android reference for the slice package.
